items.title: Disclosure: “The Government Knew She Was Not a Spy”
items.summary: Decades after their parents were executed by the US for espionage conspiracy, the government released documents that Robert and Michael Meeropol say show that their mother wasn’t a spy — and that the government knew it. (Source: Bloomberg)
